# CG-SCHEMA-902: Analysis budget exceeded

Schema comparison stopped at the configured limit.

**Why it matters:** Incomplete analysis must be visible.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Schemas](./#schema) |
| Detects | `schema.budgetExceeded` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: high |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Schema analysis stopped at {where} ({limit} reached).
>
> Deeper changes were not compared.
>
> **Fix:** Raise limits.{limit} in the configuration, or split the specification.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: tiny pair budget

With options: `{"maxSchemaPairs":1}`

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {type: string}, b: {type: string}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {type: string}, b: {type: integer}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Undetermined, high. Schema analysis stopped at POST /x: the request body (application/json) at `b` (maxSchemaPairs reached).

### Does not fire: normal budget

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {type: string}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {type: integer}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
